name: 真人
visual_style: 真人实拍的中国古装剧：真演员、真戏服、真实景，电影摄影机拍摄——自然皮肤质感、真实头发与织物，柔和自然的窗光带轻微薄雾，浅景深，克制的电影调色：朴实、写实的摄影
card_suffix: 。真实照片：真人穿真戏服，自然带毛孔的皮肤、真实头发、有接缝和褶皱的真实织物，纯中灰背景上的柔和棚光。不是CG、不是三维渲染、不是插画、不是玩偶
render_direction: 真人实拍选角定妆照：真实人物、真实戏服、自然皮肤与发质，柔和棚光，纯色背景；不要CG、三维渲染、插画、玩偶或动画化造型

source_en.video: The target video is live-action footage of a Chinese period costume drama: real actors in real costumes on a real timber set, shot on a cinema camera - natural skin texture, real hair and woven cloth, soft natural window light with a light haze, a shallow depth of field, a restrained filmic grade: plain, realistic photography.
source_en.card: Photorealistic: a real photograph of a real person in a real costume, as a casting and costume reference for a live-action Chinese period fantasy drama - natural skin texture with pores, real hair, real woven fabric with seams and creases, soft studio light on a plain mid-grey backdrop. Not CG, not a 3D render, not an illustration, not a doll.
